name: archboard
description: Internal architecture canvas: an agent states what an architecture is, the server draws it, and a person reads, compares and presents it.

scripts.dev: bunx concurrently "bun run canvas" "bun run dev:frontend"
scripts.production: bun run build && bun run canvas
scripts.lint: bun run ensure:codex-contract && bun run lint:baseline && bun run lint:policy
scripts.fix: bun scripts/lint.ts --disable-nested-config --fix --config .oxlintrc.baseline.jsonc tests frontend src/runtime/*/tests src/server/*/tests src/shared/*/tests src/cli/*/tests && bun scripts/lint.ts --type-aware --threads 1 --fix --config .oxlintrc.jsonc src scripts tools vite.config.ts && bun run lint && bun run fmt
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run fmt:check && bun run test
scripts.test: bun run ensure:codex-contract && bun run type-check && bun run build:frontend && bun run test:modules && bun run test:system && bun run test:repository && bun run test:serial-browser
scripts.type-check: bun run ensure:codex-contract && (root_typecheck_status=0; bunx tsc --noEmit || root_typecheck_status=$?; frontend_typecheck_status=0; bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.frontend.json || frontend_typecheck_status=$?; [ "$root_typecheck_status" -eq 0 ] && [ "$frontend_typecheck_status" -eq 0 ])
scripts.test:system: bun test --isolate --max-concurrency=1 --path-ignore-patterns tests/system/process-contracts/git-opener-sequence-watchdog.test.ts --path-ignore-patterns tests/system/process-contracts/cross-process-lock.test.ts tests/system/cli tests/system/canvas-state tests/system/process-contracts tests/system/code-targets tests/system/semantic-boards
scripts.lint:baseline: bun scripts/lint.ts --disable-nested-config --config .oxlintrc.baseline.jsonc tests frontend src/runtime/*/tests src/server/*/tests src/shared/*/tests src/cli/*/tests
scripts.lint:policy: bun scripts/lint.ts --type-aware --threads 1 --deny-warnings --max-warnings 0 --report-unused-disable-directives-severity error --config .oxlintrc.jsonc src scripts tools vite.config.ts
